config.style: 历史题材维京策略 RPG。剧情对白口语自然、粗犷直接，保留人物声线和情绪；叙述简洁有画面感；UI 用短而清楚的现代简体中文。人名、地名、组织、技能及专名统一使用冻结术语表译名。保留所有游戏标记、标签、变量、占位符与大小写敏感内容；仅翻译玩家可见文本。

records.source: His dismay is painted in broad strokes on his aging face.
Godwif sneers.
For all my flippancy, I must admit this is pretty much what I expected. Last summer we would have put up a much better fight, but the winter has taken its toll on us.

You rest the back of your hand on her forehead, feeling her fever against your skin - it's not the worst fever you've ever felt, but if it's lasted for several weeks, it's no small wonder she's so tired.
Wait, [i]she[/i] set the fire?
The shieldmaiden Vigundr was killed in Frisia, wielding this winged spear against unknown attackers. Her husband sold it to you in Ribe so he could afford the journey home.
{Give 50 Rations.} I wish to give an offering to Heimdallr that he may grant me vigilance.
You're free to leave. I don't care where you go, but you better get out of my town.
We'll help you fight them if that's what you want, but those who survive will not be executed. Agreed?
Sorry, my young man! Let me just rest my arthritic 25-year-old legs a moment before I leave.
Finnguala is with her future husband. They seem to have known each other for a long time.
The doubts. The bickering.

Two boys, one around 15 years of age, the other much younger, are crouched at the edge of the creek. A moment's observation reveals their errand: the older boy is teaching the younger how to tickle fish. The lesson is confined to a purely theoretical level, as the creek is much too shallow for fish.
He is round of belly and red of cheeks, with a friendly smile permanently affixed to his face, and a voice that booms across the busiest part of Market Street without at any point becoming obnoxious.
In Northumbria, you've discovered evidence of your father's final expedition. Perhaps you can find out where it all ended and get some answers at last.
I was here for-- treasure. But the robbers took it. If you help me, I'll... [i]gasp[/i]... I'll tell you how to find it.
Anything else?
You stand victorious side by side with your father and his long-dead hird. Slain jøtnar smolder on the ground, their faces distorted into expressions of pain and surprise.
But I cannot send my warriors to aid you.
If we wait until they stop expecting an attack and [i]then[/i] strike, we'll at least have a chance to reach Skule and end him before they can mobilise.
{Offer 80 Valuables.} You must've been standing here for quite some time. If I were to hand you four pence for an ale, I could make these sorry sods somebody else's problem.

[Greedy:Name] jerks free of [Boring:Name]'s hand and wades into the mud inside the circle of sticks. [Greedy:He/She] sinks a little, as [Greedy:he/she] gets close to the artifact protruding from the bog, but pays it no mind, and continues to bury [Greedy:his/her] arms in the mud in search of treasure.

One day all the gods were gathered. They decided to test the oath by throwing everything they could find at Baldr, and they saw that nothing hurt him. But his brother Loki, ever the schemer, made an arrow from mistletoe and convinced the blind god Hodr, who was also brother to them both, to shoot Baldr with it.

Ketill fishes around in his backpack and produces a delicate medallion of gilded silver, in the shape of an incomplete circle. At either of its ends is a sort of four-leaf clover with a dark red glass bead at the center. You think you've seen it before, but you never attributed any particular meaning to it.

You sit in silence for some time and listen to the quiet buzzing of insects. On the other side of the tree, [Victim:Name] lets out a mumbled curse as a wasp circles [Victim:his/her] head. The [Victim:archetype] swings ineffectually at the irritating insect, but that just seems to aggravate the creature.

records.source: In the mountains of the north, there exists a cult of warriors who call themselves the Ulfhednar. They are said to be Odinn's special warriors, who wear little except the pelt of a wolf into battle and become impervious to steel or fire. Gunnarr, the giant with the wholly ironic byname "the Peaceful", claims to be one of these berserkers.\n\nGunnarr led a group of raiders from the northern trade hub Kaupang to the isle of Orkney in the west, where he had the misfortune to meet Skule Skullcleaver. Skule convinced Gunnarr to mount a raid against your village. He may not be the most predictable huscarl in your service, but one thing is certain: it is far better to have Gunnarr on your side than against you.
records.translation: 北方群山之中，有一个战士组成的教团，自称乌尔夫赫德纳。据说他们是奥丁的亲选战士，上阵时几乎不着寸缕，只披狼皮，刀剑烈火都伤不了他们分毫。贡纳尔——这个巨人却有着一个极具讽刺意味的别名"和平者"——自称就是这些狂战士之一。\n\n贡纳尔带领一群劫掠者从北方贸易枢纽考庞出发，前往西边的奥克尼岛，却在那里不幸遇到了碎颅者斯库勒。斯库勒说服贡纳尔对你的村庄发动劫掠。他或许不是你麾下最让人放心的侍卫，但有一点是肯定的：让贡纳尔站在你这边，远好过让他与你为敌。

records.source:
You've known Nefja and her sister Eyfura since you were children. Their late father Holmunn was among your father's closest huscarls, and the sisters were often left solely in the care of their mother while he was travelling with his thegn.

The twins grew apart from an early age - where Eyfura was always her mother's beautiful and delicate girl, Nefja took more after her father and would spend her days exploring the woods, playing in the moor, or fighting with the boys. As soon as she was old enough to hold a wooden stick, she started training to be a warrior.

Over the years, the fire that burns brightly inside Nefja has turned her into a disciplined shieldmaiden, and what she lacks in raw strength is more than made up for in deftness and resolve.
records.translation:
你从小就认识内夫娅和她的姐姐埃芙拉。她们已故的父亲霍尔蒙是你父亲最亲近的侍卫之一，当他跟随领主外出时，姐妹俩常常只能由母亲独自照看。

这对双胞胎从很小的时候起就性情迥异——埃芙拉一直是母亲身边那个美丽乖巧的女孩，内夫娅则更像父亲，成日在林间探索、在荒野嬉戏，或者跟男孩们打斗。她刚能握住木棍，就开始了战士的训练。

多年来，内夫娅心中那团熊熊烈火将她锻造成了一名训练有素的盾女；她在纯粹的力量上有所欠缺，但这份不足被她的灵巧与坚毅所弥补。

records.source: Though her title is Princess of the Kingdom of Cait, Aife has few of a princess's manners and none of the typical conceits. Cait is a poor and harsh country, and Aife was raised to be as resilient and determined as any of her father's subjects. As soon as she was old enough, she was sent to train with the famous warrior Grainne, whose tutelage has turned her into a skillful trapper.\n\nGifted from an early age with equal parts curiosity and courage, Aife decided almost on a whim to join your hird. It's clear that she harbours some fascination with you and your culture. It's fortunate then that she is such a considerable asset on the field of battle.
records.translation: 尽管艾芙的头衔是凯特王国的公主，她却没有多少公主的仪态，更没有那种常见的骄矜。凯特是个贫瘠而严酷的国度，艾芙被培养得和她父亲的臣民一样坚韧果决。她刚够年纪，就被送去跟随著名的战士格兰妮训练，在格兰妮的教导下，她成了一名出色的陷阱专家。\n\n艾芙自幼便兼具好奇心与胆量，几乎是凭着一时兴起就决定加入你的亲兵队。很明显，她对你和你的文化怀有某种好奇与兴趣。所幸的是，她在战场上也确实是位难得的得力干将。
